bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null)" = true || exit 61
docker exec "$name" node -e 'fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8766/health").then(r=>process.exit(r.status===200?0:2)).catch(()=>process.exit(3))' || exit 62
if ! command -v cloudflared >/dev/null 2>&1;then echo 'STICKER_CLOUDFLARED_MISSING';exit 70;fi
found=0
for file in /etc/cloudflared/config.yml /etc/cloudflared/config.yaml "$HOME/.cloudflared/config.yml" "$HOME/.cloudflared/config.yaml";do
  test -f "$file" || continue
  if grep -Eq '(^|[.])g-acebot[.]com' "$file";then
    found=1
    if grep -q '18766' "$file";then echo 'STICKER_EXISTING_INGRESS_18766=YES';exit 0;fi
  fi
done
if test "$found" -eq 1;then echo 'STICKER_GACE_INGRESS_EXISTS_BUT_NOT_SHOP';exit 71;fi
echo 'STICKER_GACE_INGRESS_NOT_FOUND_IN_STANDARD_CONFIG';exit 72
